axes.norm_decile: 10 equal-frequency bins of raw h L2 norm, stable token-order tie breaking, computed once shared by both SAEs

dead_fraction: fraction of complete dictionary never strictly positive within that stratum; empty => undefined
fallback_reconstruction: CPU replay of sealed checkpoint on same sealed h; validate global FVU within1e-5; report dead-count difference beside sealed original
fvu: sum squared raw reconstruction error / within-stratum pooled centered sum of squares; zero variance or empty => undefined
outputs: every marginal stratum; no cross-bin search or changed E40 design
sample: unchanged E35 heldout50000 in GATE_SAMPLE document/position order
transfer_reconstruction: use sealed reconstruction.npy; recode exact pinned checkpoint on CPU for stratum firing
